english.meaning: a lifetime; counts lives or generations
english.note: 成世 means 'a whole life' and 下一世 means 'the next life'.

exampleSentences.english: Right. So you mean your arm’s dislocated and can’t move. Then you’d never be able to move it again, right?
exampleSentences.traditional: 係喎。即係你話隻手甩咗，唔郁得噉樣。噉你就係成世𠻺唔郁得𡃉喇，係唔係啊？
